dataset_title: All Pro MMA Fights - UFC, Bellator, One
license: CC0-1.0 / Public Domain dedication as displayed by Kaggle

semantics.coverage: Professional fights in UFC, Bellator MMA and ONE Championship through the author's 2021-08-11 retrieval date.
limitations: This is a 2021 frozen snapshot and is not a complete worldwide MMA history.
Source fighter names/URLs must be identity-resolved before joining Greco UFCStats history.
A fight appearing in both this dataset and Greco must not be double-counted.
Method labels and promotion/event strings are source vocabulary and must be normalized only in the canonical layer.
Historical record/experience features must be rebuilt chronologically from fight rows, never from later career totals.
semantics.primary_use_candidate: Pre-UFC and cross-promotion professional fight-history context for fighters who later appear in UFC Edge canonical identity.

upstream_origin: Scraped from Sherdog by the Kaggle dataset author.
